messages:
Anya: FYI I'm going to roll a shadow apply for `routing.rate_limit.fallback_policy` on staging in 15m. goal: surface behavioral diffs without impacting live routing.
Jamal: nice. which fallback are you enabling? the token-bucket->leaky-bucket change?
Anya: yep moving to leaky-bucket w/ burst smoothing. config key `routing.rate_limit.fallback=leaky_bucket_smooth`. shadow=true so runtime will compute but not enforce.
Sven: important: ensure shadow mode still samples requests for full trace payload so we can compare latency and quota hit rates. otherwise we won't catch efficacy regressions.
Anya: plan: 1) 1% global sampling + full-trace for sampled 2) write a trace diff with anonymized tenant_hash + cohort label 3) persist traces for 7d
Marta: console: can we surface a side-by-side table in the preview panel showing current vs shadow aggregates (p95 p50 error_rate qps)? ops kept asking for that last time.
Jamal: API note: let's change preview apply to return 202 and a `preview_id`. clients currently assume synchronous. don't want polling surprises.
Sven: agree on 202. also include `estimated_propagation_ms` and `affected_shards` in the preview response so Optimize can show cost estimates.
Anya: will add that. telemetry question: avoid cardinality explosion on metrics with cohort + tenant. Suggest emitting cohort-level aggregated metrics and a sampled event stream for tenant-level incidents.
Marta: +1. UI should let you click a cohort to expand sampled tenant events (with redacted IDs) instead of raw high-card metrics.
Jamal: runbook: if diff shows >10% tail latency regression or >2% increase in 403s for a cohort, auto-pause the preview and notify #eng-oncall. who owns manual rollback?
Sven: ops owns the auto-pause; config owner (Anya's team) must ack to resume. add an ops-bot action to pause and create an incident draft with traces attached.
Anya: setting pause thresholds to p95 latency +10% or error_rate +1.5% (absolute). will draft runbook and PR.
Marta: UX: add an "Explain diff" link that opens a pre-filtered trace view and the exact preview snapshot diff (JSON) with human-readable bullets. saves us from manual triage.
Jamal: also log the operator who approves the final apply and the preview_id + git commit in audit ledger. essential for deterministic rollback.
deploy-bot: preview-created by anya/shadow-fallback 0 files changed 0 http://ci.redwood/internal/6689
Anya: launching shadow at T+15. tagging you all on the PR that adds the 202 preview semantics + preview snapshot S3 persistence (30d).
Sven: thanks. pls include the sampled-event sampling rate as a runtime knob (default 1/200). we might need to ramp.
Marta: noted. after 2 hours we'll run the replay job to compute cost/delta for Optimize. queue it to avoid colliding with nightly jobs.
Jamal: cool. keep me on the loop for the API change. I'll review the schema.
Anya: will do. starting prep now.
